effect: Miro's own-fob check and demonstration completed the practical handoff; both chapter goals are complete.

mostWorthwhile.text: The practice-panel sequence was most worthwhile: operators located and repaired a real fault, then Miro repeated the check under his own authorization.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the panel after locating the fault was a little mechanical: its sole partner was automatically used, so there was little decision to make at that point.

surprise.text: I expected the bell to connect directly to the neighbor link, but it first had to be fitted to the spare repeater and bench-tested.

arbitrary.text: The bell-to-repeater pairing was not obvious to me initially, although the matched fault contact explained its purpose afterward.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the tested handoff and alarm made the neighborhood's infrastructure feel like something people can actually maintain, and I am curious how it holds up.
